liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Reviewer found it out of key [9]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Playing in the Band into Crazy Fingers was judged stale [9]
- **Drums** (1 other source): Uploader lists a jam segment after Drums leading into All Along the Watchtower [1]
- **All Along the Watchtower** (1 review): Described as disjointed [8]
- **Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds** (1 review): Reviewer says the Lucy was the only enjoyable part of the show [10]

## The recordings

- **gd93-05-15.schoeps.fink.17955.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 16 songs; 136 min; rated 4.08/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording fantastic sounding, assuming it came from front of board position; Reviewer says the audience tape is not the best, and a soundboard-sounding source would be better [8][17]
- **gd1993-05-15.fob.schoeps.unknown.32091.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 138 min; rated 2.2/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this FOB Schoeps recording far better of the two versions then on the archive [16]
- **gd1993-05-15.137246.mk41.miller.flac1648**: source not stated; 16 songs; 137 min; rated 1.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1993-05-15.140130.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 16 songs; 130 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- From the bleachers, the first three songs were inaudible because of Healy's sound mix [9]
- Reviewer's brother slept through drums and woke to a completely empty stadium [10]
- Reviewer drove 17 hours from Portland to attend [10]
- Clouds, light rain and drizzle lasted most of the day into the first set, with notable lightning [11]
- Parking lot scene outside was friendly; the sky still drizzled into set break [11]
- Sky cleared for second set, and a broken rainbow hung overhead for a long while [13]
- Rain and lightning occurred in the desert during the show [14]
- Reviewer recalls a lightning storm approaching during the show [15]
- Second set's first half is very hot, while the performance falters after drums [8]
- Reviewer says the show is no match for the 5-15-83 show, ten years earlier, and calls it mellow [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-05-15.schoeps.fink.17955.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul B. and Alan J. Fink; source: Audience: Schoeps MK21's [1]. Also: Recorded with Schoeps CMC 521 microphones to DAT, then CDR, then converted to SHN by Alan J Fink [1]
- **gd1993-05-15.fob.schoeps.unknown.32091.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by unknown; source: FOBH 30' center Schoeps Mk-41 3.5" @ 90* ( 1/2 O.R.T.F ) > Schoeps KC5 Actives > CMC 4 > Canare Star Quad > Kock Power Supply > Canare Star Quad > Koch… [2]
- **gd1993-05-15.137246.mk41.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Schoeps MK41 -> Dat (Panasonic SV-255/48k) [3]
- **gd1993-05-15.140130.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Sam Boyd Silver Bowl - May 15, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/may-15-1993) [20]
- Poster by www.gdao.org: [Grateful Dead, Sting. Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, Las Vegas, Nevada, May 14-16, 1993 · Grateful Dead Archive Online · Grateful](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/377250) [21]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-05-15 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-05-15-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [22]
